summary: Runtime dependency sourced from mutable GitHub user repo (libsignal)
details: package.json declares the runtime dependency `libsignal` as `github:tenka-san/libsignal-node` — a bare GitHub user/repo reference with no commit SHA, no version pin, and no integrity hash. On `npm install`, npm fetches whatever bytes are currently at that repo's HEAD and installs them, including executing any lifecycle scripts the fetched tree declares. The owner of `tenka-san/libsignal-node` (a personal user account, not an established publisher of a libsignal distribution) can change the referenced code at any time without any change to this package, and the mutable ref bypasses registry-side scanning and integrity checks. This is an off-registry dependency source: the manifest line itself is the install-time code-execution vector.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
